Mother Arrested for Allegedly Drowning Infant Daughter in Hyderabad Lake

Police in Hyderabad have arrested a woman for allegedly drowning her nine-month-old daughter in the Bairamalguda lake. The incident reportedly occurred in Bairamalguda. The Free Press Journal also reported that police foiled an attempt related to ₹5 Lakh in connection with the incident. The woman was taken into custody following the discovery.
